name: io.github.nisioka/personal-knowledge-mcp
title: Personal Knowledge
description: Self-hosted MCP server for a personal knowledge base: scoped search, ingestion, expiry reminders

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token matching a principal in PK_TOKENS. Use 'Bearer full-dev-token' only with the built-in dev tokens on loopback.

environmentVariables.name: PK_PORT
environmentVariables.description: TCP port the MCP server listens on.

environmentVariables.name: PK_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind address. A non-loopback value requires PK_TOKENS: with the built-in dev tokens the server exits instead of listening.

environmentVariables.name: PK_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite database file. Use an absolute path outside the install directory.

environmentVariables.name: PK_TOKENS
environmentVariables.description: JSON map of bearer token to principal (name, scopes, defaultWriteScope). Unset falls back to built-in dev tokens, and the server then refuses to bind anywhere but loopback.

environmentVariables.name: PK_DB_PASSPHRASE
environmentVariables.description: Optional SQLCipher passphrase. When set, the whole database file is encrypted at rest. Losing it makes the database and its backups unrecoverable.

environmentVariables.name: PK_EMBEDDING_DIM
environmentVariables.description: Embedding vector dimension. Fixed when the database is created; changing it requires a fresh database.
